_comment: Copied to ~/oid-quote/config.json on first install (never overwritten). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Restart after edits: launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.oid.quote-collector
_wide_archive_keep_days_note: WIDECP 2026-10-20: raised from 21 to 3650 so the collector never prunes wide JSONL early; like the core, JSONL older than 90 days is deleted only by com.oid.archive.wide-weekly (oid_archive.integrity) once Parquet covers it, and Parquet is kept.
